data_description.name: Shown in the sidebar. You can add multiple panels, each with its own configuration.

init.title: Access and dashboard integration
init.description: Choose which signed-in users should see this dashboard in the DashboardModern UI. This is a frontend visibility filter, not a replacement for Home Assistant permissions. Lovelace registration makes DashboardModern appear in Settings → Dashboards.

data.register_lovelace_dashboard: Also register as a Home Assistant dashboard

data_description.allowed_users: UI visibility filter only. Home Assistant permissions still govern data and service access.
data_description.register_lovelace_dashboard: The dashboard is created the first time an administrator opens DashboardModern.
data_description.admin_only: Native Home Assistant filter; it takes precedence for non-administrator accounts.
data_description.check_updates: Asks GitHub every half hour whether a newer release is out, and shows it under Settings → Updates. Turn it off to keep the panel from reaching the internet at all; the dashboard itself never needs it.
data_description.tickets_enabled: Lets anyone using the dashboard report a bug, suggest a feature or ask for help without leaving it. The report becomes a public issue on GitHub, opened under their own account — the same one HACS already asked them for. Turn it off and nothing leaves the house.

confirm.title: Restart Home Assistant
confirm.description: Version {version} is installed on disk. Restart Home Assistant to load it.
